pairs.subject: agent-browser-control
pairs.evidence: app/login/LoginClient.tsx:46 This context is a human-facing sign-in form whose only I/O is a fetch to the app's own auth API. A case-insensitive grep of app/login for playwright, puppeteer, daemon, chromium, mcp, snapshot, locator, cdp and selector returned no hits, so this context gives no agent a browser and none of the five techniques' preconditions hold.

techniques.evidence: app/login/LoginClient.tsx:46 No browser process is spawned or kept alive. The page runs inside a user's browser and posts credentials.
app/login/LoginClient.tsx:46 No agent names or acts on elements here. There is no snapshot or ref vocabulary.
app/login/LoginClient.tsx:46 No daemon listener or tunnel exists here. page.tsx reads x-forwarded-host only to build a redirect origin, not to decide whether a request is local for a browser daemon.
app/login/LoginClient.tsx:46 There is no browser command registry to classify as read, write or meta.
app/login/LoginClient.tsx:65 The outcome classification feeds a human user's UI (toasts and inline error), not an agent recovering from a failed browser action.
